page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highcpu-64 is a compute-focused instance powered by AMD EPYC 9B45 processors on the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 64 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled (2 threads per core). It includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster. The instance is configured with 128 GB of system memory, establishing a 2 GB per vCPU ratio. No local disk storage or hardware accelerators are bundled with this instance type, requiring network-attached storage for persistent file systems.

Performance benchmarks place the processor within the top ten percent for single-core and multi-core evaluations. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2,545.0 and a multi-core score of 24,713.0, backed by strong software compilation throughput of 63,071.0 points under Clang. The presence of vector extensions—including AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16—supports high-throughput instruction sets, reflected in a PassMark CPU extended instructions score of 112,137.73 and overall CPU score of 91,107.09. Memory operations sustain 203.88 GB/s read and 127.63 GB/s write throughput for uncached blocks, with single-threaded gzip compression processing 37.19 GB/s.

With its 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation, this configuration offers strong compute density for processing tasks that do not demand extensive RAM pools. The absence of integrated local NVMe storage necessitates external volume provisioning, which represents a storage architectural dependency. The instance profile aligns with CPU-intensive workloads including continuous integration pipelines, software compilation, batch processing, data compression, and web serving.
description: Google Cloud Platform n4d-highcpu-64 is a compute-oriented virtual server featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs from 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9B45 x86_64 processor and 128 GB of RAM. Designed with a 2 GB per vCPU ratio, it incorporates AVX-512 instruction sets, cryptographic hardware acceleration, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Benchmarks position the instance in the top tier for single-core and multi-core processing, highlighted by a Geekbench score of 24,713.0 and strong software compilation throughput. It lacks integrated local NVMe storage and discrete GPUs, relying on remote block storage for persistent data. This instance profile is suited for compute-heavy batch processing, CI/CD compilation, and web serving.
